title: King John seals Magna Carta
summary: King John sealed Magna Carta at Runnymede in 1215 during a conflict with his barons. The charter addressed particular grievances and limits on royal action.

claims.text: King John sealed Magna Carta at Runnymede in 1215 during a conflict with his barons. The charter addressed particular grievances and limits on royal action.
Source dates sealing to 15 June 1215 in the historical calendar; year precision is used here.
The document’s original setting differs from later uses as a symbol of rights. It should not be read as an immediate grant of equal political rights to everyone.
